author: Endertait
body:
Just to let you know this map was accepted but i never made it into dev to sort it out. Then the person putting it in map rotations got banned so i thought i would post it again.

Hi my name is Matthew (matty01matthew)
Da_Baus & I have made this map named: Eudorix.

Here is the view: http://imgur.com/a/zg4cM#0
The Map & YML File (.rar, you will need to unzip the file): https://www.mediafire.com/?c89ichqhxncrvk6
.
This map contains:
-one side green
-one side blue
-sand/beach one side
-pool/forest other
-bridges that cross map
-sniping areas on top of spawn
And we hope you like it :)
Thanks,
Matty01matthew and Da_Baus
